flags.why: Tham ô means embezzling entrusted assets, whereas 'to be corrupt' includes other misconduct ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-tham%20%C3%B4)).
'Corruption' and 'graft' are broader than the specific misappropriation denoted by tham ô ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-tham%20%C3%B4)).
Vạt can refer to a garment's back panel as well as its front panel ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/v%E1%BA%A1t)).
flags.fix: panel or flap of a garment (e.g. of an áo dài)

flags.why: A gáo is a dipper and need not be made from coconut shell ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/g%C3%A1o)).
Chơi đàn does not specify that the instrument is a piano.
flags.fix: He improvises on an instrument without sheet music.
